# Titanic Quarter Cycling Club (TQCC)

> Belfast based community cycling club since 2014. Weekly group rides for all abilities, from beginners to experienced riders. Based in Titanic Quarter, Belfast, Northern Ireland.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.titanicquartercc.com/): Club overview, upcoming events, Strava activity, and latest newsletter
- [About](https://www.titanicquartercc.com/about): Club history, founding story, kit design, and constitution
- [Membership](https://www.titanicquartercc.com/membership): How to join, taster rides, fees, ride groups (A/B1/B2/B3/C), and what to bring
- [Rides & Events](https://www.titanicquartercc.com/rides-events): Weekly ride schedule, upcoming and past events, ride leader info
- [Summer Solstice Sportive](https://www.titanicquartercc.com/sportive): Annual evening sportive open to all — TQCC's flagship event
- [Contact](https://www.titanicquartercc.com/contact): Email, social media, and meeting point location
- [Boccia](https://www.titanicquartercc.com/boccia): TQCC's boccia section and NI Boccia League
- [Gallery](https://www.titanicquartercc.com/gallery): Club photos

## About TQCC

Titanic Quarter Cycling Club was founded in November 2014, inspired by the 2013 Giro d'Italia Big Start in Belfast. The club offers weekly group rides at five pace levels (A, B1, B2, B3, C) catering to all abilities. Rides depart from SPAR Titanic Quarter in Belfast.

Membership is through primarily through Cycling Ireland, but other membership options are available. New riders can try two taster rides before joining. The club kit features yellow and black colours referencing the Titanic and White Star Line, with a pink stripe honouring the Giro d'Italia.

The annual Summer Solstice Sportive is the only TQCC event open to non-members, held in memory of founding member Philip Corr.
